the delisting of the equity shares of Hitech Corporation Limited ("the Company”)

Sub: Outcome of Board meeting
Ref: Regulation 30 and other applicable provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
Regulations, 2015
Further to our intimation dated 05 October 2026, regarding the board of directors meeting pursuant to
regulation 29(1) of SEBI (LODR) regulations, the Board at their meeting held on Thursday, 15 October 2026
has inter-alia, transacted the following items of business:
1.

Approved the Un-audited financial results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year
ended 30 September 2026 – Annexure -A

2. Approved the Appointment of Mr. Sandip Mishra as the Senior VP & Chief Human Resources Officer and
Senior Managerial Personnel of the company – Annexure -B
3.

Approved the grant of 10,000 Stock Units Under Cyient DLM RSU Scheme, 2023 and 2,63,400 options
under Cyient DLM ASOP Scheme 2023 to the associates of the Company.

We request you to kindly take the above on record as per the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
The Meeting of Board of Directors of the Company commenced at 02:00 P.M and concluded at 04:10 P.M IST
The above announcement will be made available on the Company’s website www.cyientdlm.com.

Dear Sir/Madam,
With reference to the captioned subject and pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities Exchange Board of
India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”), we
hereby inform your good office that the Board of Directors of HMA Agro Industries Limited (“the
Company”) at their Meeting held today, i.e., on October 15, 2026, has, inter-alia, considered and approved
the following:
The Request Letter received from Mr. Wajid Ahmed (“Outgoing Promoter”) on October 03, 2026, for his
reclassification from ‘Promoter & Promoter Group’ Category to ‘Public’ Category pursuant to the Family
Settlement Agreement dated September 20, 2026, which shall be subject to the approval of stock exchanges
and/or such other approval, if any, as may be necessary in this regard, in terms of the provisions of Regulation
31A of the Listing Regulations.
The Meeting of the Board of Directors commenced at 03:30 P.M and concluded at 03:46 P.M.
In this regard and as per the provisions of Regulation 31A(8)(b) of the Listing Regulations, we are hereby
enclosing the views of the board on the aforesaid reclassification in “Annexure I”.

VIEWS OF BOARD ON THE PROPOSED RE-CLASSIFICATION FROM ‘PROMOTER &
PROMOTER GROUP’ CATEGORY TO ‘PUBLIC’ CATEGORY
The Chairman informed the Board of Directors (“Board”) that the Company had received a request letter dated
September 23, 2026 on October 03, 2026, from Mr. Wajid Ahmed (“Outgoing Promoter”) pursuant to the
Family Settlement Agreement dated September 20, 2026 seeking re-classification of his shareholding from
persons belonging to the ‘Promoter & Promoter Group’ Category to ‘Public’ Category under Regulation 31A of
the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
(“Listing Regulations”). The Company intimated about the request letter received for reclassification to BSE
Limited (“BSE”) and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (“NSE”) (“Stock Exchanges”) on Saturday,
October 03, 2026.
The Board was further informed that the Outgoing Promoter doesn’t hold any Equity Shares in the Company,
representing NIL percentage of the paid-up equity share capital of the Company
The Board further discussed and considered the facts and circumstances relating to the proposed reclassification
and noted that the aforementioned Outgoing Promoter is not involved in the management of the Company and
does not exercise control over the affairs of the Company, directly or indirectly. Also, as on the date of receipt of
reclassification requests from the Outgoing Promoter, it has been noted that he holds less than 10% voting rights
in the Company and does not possess any kind of special rights in the Company. The Board also noted that the
Outgoing Promoter neither represents the board of directors (including as a nominee director) of the Company nor
is acting as a Key Managerial Person in the Company. The Board also noted that the Outgoing Promoter is neither
a ‘wilful defaulter’ as per the Reserve Bank of India Guidelines nor a fugitive economic offender.
Furthermore, the Board noted that the outgoing promoter has entered into a Family Settlement Agreement dated
September 20, 2026 with Mohammad Kamil Qureshi, Zulfiqar Ahmad Qurashi, Mohammad Ashraf
Qureshi, Mohammad Mehmood Qureshi and Gulzar Ahmad (the existing Promoters of the Company),
whereby it has been agreed to that he will not hold any shareholding in the Company and possess no control over
the affairs of the Company in any manner whatsoever and Mohammad Kamil Qureshi, Zulfiqar Ahmad
Qurashi, Mohammad Ashraf Qureshi, Mohammad Mehmood Qureshi and Gulzar Ahmad will continue as
the promotors of the Company.
The Board further noted that the Company is compliant with the requirement for Minimum Public Shareholding
as required under Regulation 38 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
and the proposed reclassification is not being initiated for achieving the Minimum Public Shareholding. The
trading in the shares of the company has not been suspended by the Stock Exchanges. The Company does not
have any outstanding due to the SEBI, the Stock Exchanges or Depositories.
Accordingly on the basis of the rationale and the confirmation provided by them, Family Settlement Agreement
dated September 20, 2026 and in accordance with the provisions of Regulation 31A of the Listing Regulations,
the Board was of the view that the above mentioned request for reclassification be accepted and approved by the
Board of Directors of the Company, which shall be subject to the approval of stock exchanges and/or such other
approval, if any, as may be necessary in this regard.

Subject: Outcome of the Board Meeting held on October 15, 2026
Dear Sir/Madam,
Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 51 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (“SEBI”) (Listing Obligations
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”), as amended from time to time, we
wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e., Thursday,
October 15, 2026, inter alia, considered and/or approved the following matters:
1. The Consolidated and Standalone Unaudited Financial Results (“Financial Results”) of the Company for
the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. In this regard, following are enclosed:
a. The Unaudited Financial Results along with the Limited Review Report for the quarter and half-year
ended September 30, 2026, as required under Regulations 33 and 52 of the Listing Regulations
(enclosed as Annexure A);
b. Disclosures in accordance with Regulation 52(4) of the Listing Regulations;
c. Security Cover Certificate pursuant to Regulations 54 and 56 of the Listing Regulations read with
Circular No. HO/17 /11/12(2)2026-DDHS-PODl/I/22420/2026 dated September 28, 2026, as
amended from time to time (enclosed as Annexure B);
d. Statement of Utilization of Issue Proceeds & Statement of Deviation and Variation in use of Issue
Proceeds of Non-Convertible Securities during the quarter ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to
Regulations 52(7) & 52(7A) of the Listing Regulations (enclosed as Annexure C);
2. Based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, re-designation of
Mr. R Venkataraman (DIN: 00011919) from Joint Managing Director to Non-Executive Non-Independent
Director of the Company, w.e.f. October 15, 2026, subject to Members’ approval. He will cease to be a
Key Managerial Personnel of the Company. Mr. R Venkataraman’s executive role is with IIFL Capital
Services Limited. He has never drawn any compensation from IIFL Finance Limited. (The disclosures
required under Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations read with the applicable SEBI Circular(s) are enclosed as Annexure D); and
